title: Antiepileptic Drug Profiles and Important Contraindications
subject: Drug of Choice
preview: Antiseizure drugs differ in sodium-channel, calcium-channel and synaptic transmitter mechanisms.
quickRevision: Antiseizure drugs differ in sodium-channel, calcium-channel and synaptic transmitter mechanisms.
Carbamazepine can cause hyponatremia and serious drug interactions through enzyme induction.
Choice depends on seizure type, comorbidities, pregnancy potential and concomitant medicines.

sections.title: Essential distinctions
points: Antiseizure drugs differ in sodium-channel, calcium-channel and synaptic transmitter mechanisms.
Valproate carries major pregnancy-related fetal risks and requires specialist consideration in people who may become pregnant.
